title: Does it feel to anyone else like the Dune films have absolutely no replay value?

commenti.body: A friend has only seen the first one and wants to do them both together so she can see the whole story. We regularly do longer term movie watches (5 part War & Piece over a week was epic). I'm a fan of the universe. I'm very curious to rewatch Dune part. 2, it's Part 1 that I don't wanna rewatch. Part 2 feels like it had all the complexity that Part 1 lacked.

I actually enjoyed Dune Part 1 more on my second viewing. And I saw Dune Part 2 three times in the theater. The only thing I will say is that for Part 2 it's been hard to want to rewatch it at home because it really was an awesome experience for me on the big screen.
